# Seen public FBA development fixture

Copied byte-for-byte from the already saved artifacts/fba-pilot-20261025 textbook model. Original COBRApy distribution URL, Git blob SHA-1, XML SHA-256 and official scalar objective reference are recorded in source-receipt.json. This is public, already seen development material, not an independent holdout. The complete source XML notes and annotations are preserved.

Two HiGHS algorithms share one solver engine. Matching the official objective does not validate a unique flux vector or biological applicability.
